name: llm-transpile
description: Auto-compress .md, .html, .txt files read by Claude Code via PostToolUse hook.

interface.shortDescription: Token-optimized document reader — reduces token usage up to 90% on HTML, ~27% on Markdown (cl100k-measured).
interface.longDescription: Silently compresses .md, .html, and .txt files on Read via PostToolUse hook, cutting context usage by up to 40% with zero workflow change.
